method: Manual role classification with exact hypergeometric hand-draw calculations. Odyssey Limited test collation is now locked separately to the core FIN-style Play Booster v1 model. The diagnostic decks remain hand-built: no draft picks, opponent decisions or actual games are simulated.

pairs.assessment: Two common direct-return spells (005, 007) now support both signposts. Mentor and Nausicaa also explicitly reward turning face up; the common Omen and Nausicaa Adventure supply hidden creatures. Casting a foretold creature still enters from the stack. Mentor’s recognition untap is capped once each turn; choose timing carefully around Survival.

signposts.name: Mentor, Trusted Counselor
signposts.rules:
Whenever one or more cards are exiled from your library for the first time each turn, tap up to one target creature an opponent controls.
Whenever a permanent you control enters from exile or is turned face up, untap up to one target creature you control. This ability triggers only once each turn.

signposts.name: Nausicaa, Princess of Scheria

pairs.assessment: Tiresias has Foretell, Escape and recovery support. Circe has two common Manifest sources but no friendly common Aura in these colours. Enchantment creatures do not satisfy enchanted. Plan: make the face-down sacrifice line the initial Circe test; do not count the Omens as creature enchantment.

signposts.name: Tiresias, Voice Below
signposts.rules: Once each turn, when one or more cards leave your graveyard or you cast a spell from exile, target opponent mills two cards. If two or more cards left your graveyard this turn, surveil 1.

signposts.name: Circe, Witch of Aeaea
signposts.rules: Whenever one or more creatures you control that are face down or enchanted die, draw a card, then discard a card. This ability triggers only once each turn.

pairs.assessment: Two attack-trigger signposts supply repeatable outlets, and black has several death effects. Only colourless Salt-Cured Fish supplies Food at common in this pair. Plan: test artifact/creature sacrifice first; treat Hearthfire Cook as cross-pair support rather than a BR theme guarantee.

signposts.name: Eurylochus, Voice of Doubt
signposts.rules: Whenever Eurylochus attacks, you may sacrifice another creature. If you do, exile the top card of your library. You may play it this turn.

signposts.name: Melanthius, Treacherous Goatherd
signposts.rules: Whenever Melanthius attacks, you may sacrifice an artifact or another creature. When you do, exile the top card of your library. You may play that card until the end of your next turn.

pairs.assessment: Five common Survival bodies, big creatures and shared Vehicles form a clear route. Early untap tricks compete with Survival; using them can still be correct to save a creature. Plan: compare attack-first and crew-first lines without automatically moving every untap to the end step.

signposts.name: Polites, First Through the Door
signposts.rules: Trample. Survival — At the beginning of your second main phase, if Polites is tapped, put a +1/+1 counter on him if he was blocked this turn. Then you may have him fight target creature you do not control.

signposts.name: Euryalus, Phaeacian Champion
signposts.rules: Whenever Euryalus becomes tapped during your turn, he gets +1/+0 and gains trample until end of turn. Survival — At the beginning of your second main phase, if Euryalus is tapped, add {R}{G}. Until end of turn, you do not lose this mana as steps and phases end.

pairs.assessment: The pair has seven coloured common Food sources plus Salt-Cured Fish, four Survival bodies and cheap white creatures. Laertes has Libation Attendant, Traveler’s Amulet and Olive-Oil Lamp as common nonland MV1 recovery targets, alongside lands. Plan: test whether this narrow second signpost earns its slot.

signposts.name: Eumaeus, Loyal Swineherd
signposts.rules: Survival — At the beginning of your second main phase, if Eumaeus is tapped, create a Food token. Whenever you sacrifice a Food, put a +1/+1 counter on another target creature.

signposts.name: Laertes, Rooted Patriarch
signposts.rules: Survival — At the beginning of your second main phase, if Laertes is tapped, you may return target permanent card with mana value 1 or less from your graveyard to your hand.

pairs.assessment: Antinous consumes another creature or Food at your end step, grows and drains opponents. Medon rewards creature deaths while protecting continuity through recovery. Common Food sources 008, 108 and 136 and death-effect creatures supply the engine. The timing prevents an ordinary free sacrifice outlet on demand; copied triggers and extra end steps remain possible.

signposts.name: Antinous, First Suitor
signposts.rules: At the beginning of your end step, you may sacrifice another creature or a Food. If you do, put a +1/+1 counter on Antinous and each opponent loses 1 life.

signposts.name: Medon, Herald Who Endured
signposts.rules: When Medon enters, return up to one target permanent card with mana value 2 or less from your graveyard to your hand. Whenever another creature you control dies, you gain 1 life.

pairs.assessment: Aeolus rewards Vehicles while the Wooden Horse rewards instants/sorceries. Flash Omens are enchantment spells and do not feed the Saga’s recovery or discount. Plan: test a Vehicle deck with useful instants; do not label every spell as instant/sorcery support.

signposts.name: Song of the Wooden Horse
signposts.rules:
I — You may discard a card. If you do, draw a card.
II — Return up to one target instant or sorcery card from your graveyard to your hand.
III — The next instant or sorcery spell you cast this turn costs {2} less to cast.

signposts.name: Aeolus, Lord of the Winds

pairs.assessment: Five common own-graveyard departure sources across the pair, counting Maidservants targeting your own graveyard; Escape can move several cards at once, while land recovery needs a land in the graveyard and a tapped worker. Plan: track available fuel and legal recovery objects, not just mill counts.

signposts.name: Anticleia, Shade of Home
signposts.rules: Whenever one or more cards leave your graveyard for the first time each turn, put a +1/+1 counter on Anticleia. When Anticleia dies, mill two cards, then you may return a land card from your graveyard to your hand.

signposts.name: Keeper of Ancestral Graves
signposts.rules: At the beginning of your end step, mill two cards. Whenever one or more permanent cards leave your graveyard for the first time each turn, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature and you gain 1 life.

pairs.assessment: Three colourless Vehicles and three common Survival bodies are accessible. Delayed ship recovery preserves Survival. Plan: test the three-mana ship and team-tap spell together for overly decisive attacks; resolve Telemachus after other relevant Survival triggers.

signposts.name: Ithacan Deck-Captain
signposts.rules:
Vehicles you control have haste.
Survival — At the beginning of your second main phase, if this creature is tapped and a Vehicle you control attacked this turn, create a 1/1 red and white Human Sailor creature token.

signposts.name: Telemachus, Returned Son
signposts.rules: Survival — At the beginning of your second main phase, if Telemachus is tapped, another target creature you control gets +1/+1 until your next turn. If a Vehicle you control attacked this turn, untap that creature.

pairs.assessment: Two common Manifest sources feed both signposts. Four owned cards in exile is a separate, demanding threshold: foretold cards stop contributing after being cast. Plan: measure sustained exile counts; do not infer four cards in exile from four past exile events.

signposts.name: Voyage into Unknown Shores
signposts.rules: Whenever you manifest fate for the first time each turn, you may put a land card from your hand onto the battlefield tapped. At the beginning of your end step, if you own four or more cards in exile, draw a card.

signposts.name: Calypso, Keeper of Ogygia
signposts.rules: Whenever one or more cards are exiled from your library for the first time each turn, put a +1/+1 counter on up to one target face-down creature you control. {4}{G}{U}: Target face-down creature you control gets +3/+3 and gains trample until end of turn.

fixedDefects.fix: Choose the small creature during resolution so newly milled cards are eligible.

fixedDefects.issue: Adding enchantment type enables unintended self-recovery.
fixedDefects.fix: Recover another enchantment card; maintain access to other enchantments.

remainingGates: Run pack/table supply and then pick-behaviour simulations under the locked collation before making draft-access claims.
Expose the canonical Manifest Fate reminder; published card records use the custom action without defining it. Audit uses existing reference notes: top two, manifest one, exile the other.
WU recognition and WB exploitation now have revised cards; rates, repeatability and draft access still need games.
Play these lists; these calculations are not results of played games.

collationModel.note: The Odyssey candidate has no external Through the Ages-style bonus sheet. Seven ordinary common slots are the default; FIN's one-third common replacement is retained only as a sensitivity case.
